description: List or search published authors. Omit q to browse all records. Returns the public REST representation, pagination totals and next/previous REST links; increment page to continue. Books include categories, publisher-maintained overall availability (unknown is not unavailable), and structured purchase_destinations ordered with verified Amazon.com links first. This ordering does not change book recommendation/catalog ranking. No live retailer stock is provided. Includes publication-filtered relationships and public links. Use get_author for a known ID. Large pages may require a smaller per_page; content is never silently truncated.

q.description: Optional text search; omit to list the entire published collection. Articles search title, subtitle, excerpt and byline, not full body.

sort.description: Catalog ordering, ascending ID, or descending ID.

name: search_authors
